name: Boots of the Winding Path
descriptionHtml: While wearing these boots, you can take a Bonus Action|XPHB to teleport up to 15 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. You must have occupied that space at some point during the current turn.

name: Helm of Awareness
descriptionHtml: While wearing this helmet, you have Advantage|XPHB on Initiative|XPHB rolls.

name: Manifold Tool
descriptionHtml: This tool takes the form of a wrench, a screwdriver, or another basic tool. As a Magic action, you can touch the item and transform it into a type of Artisan's Tools of your choice. Whatever form the tool takes, you have proficiency with it when you use it.

name: Mind Sharpener
descriptionHtml: The item has 4 charges. When you fail a Constitution saving throw to maintain Concentration|XPHB, you can take a Reaction|XPHB and expend 1 of the item's charges to succeed instead. The item regains 1d4 expended charges daily at dawn.

name: Repulsion Shield
descriptionHtml:
You gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class|XPHB while wielding this shield.

The shield has 4 charges. While holding it, when a Large or smaller creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack roll, you can take a Reaction|XPHB to expend 1 of the shield's charges and push the attacker up to 15 feet straight away. The shield regains 1d4 expended charges daily at dawn.

name: Spell-Refueling Ring
descriptionHtml: While wearing this ring, you can recover one expended spell slot as a Bonus Action|XPHB. The recovered slot can be of level 3 or lower. Once used, the ring can't be used again until the next dawn.
